hypotheses.S0_large_disjoint_atlas_completed: The atlas contains 16,000 semantic-discovery sites, 32,000 disjoint FineWeb sites, and 12,800 sites from each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.S1_weight_axes_have_lexical_semantics: Frozen output axes have median held-out vocabulary AUROC at least 0.65 against preregistered token labels.
hypotheses.S2_weight_axes_are_more_semantic_than_ro: Native HOSVD axes exceed the p95 median AUROC of independently selected random rotations of the same rank-16 output subspace by at least 0.03.
hypotheses.S3_target_adjoint_semantics_transfer: Frozen per-axis target-adjoint explanations have median AUROC at least 0.60 on FineWeb, WikiText, and TinyStories.
hypotheses.S4_top1_adjoint_semantics_transfer: Frozen per-axis top1-adjoint explanations have median AUROC at least 0.60 on FineWeb, WikiText, and TinyStories.
hypotheses.S5_output_variables_dominate_axis_labels: At least 12 of 16 target-adjoint and 12 of 16 top1-adjoint axes select their corresponding output-token variable rather than current token or position.
hypotheses.S6_output_subspace_has_transferable_sema: A discovery-frozen linear decoder from the complete rank-16 output subspace has median AUROC at least 0.65 on every corpus for both target and top1 label families.
hypotheses.S7_weight_and_natural_roles_agree: At least half of axes select the same base token property in weight-only vocabulary geometry and either target- or top1-adjoint semantics.
hypotheses.S8_rotation_control_is_matched: Every rotation control is an orthogonal change of coordinates inside the exact same rank-16 physical output subspace.
